insights.title: Portfolio tracks 87 raw materials
insights.text: The tracked universe spans 87 raw materials this cycle — averaging +10.5% week-on-week.

insights.title: FEED ADDITIVE spikes as WHEAT BRAN slides
insights.text: FEED ADDITIVE posted the sharpest weekly gain at +330.4%, while WHEAT BRAN fell -40.0% WoW; 34 of 81 priced materials moved more than ±10% week-on-week.

insights.title: LIMESTONE POWDER cheapest, L-METHIONINE most expensive
insights.text: LIMESTONE POWDER remains the lowest-priced tracked material at roughly $62/MT, while L-METHIONINE is the most expensive at about $4,950/MT.

insights.title: 48 materials flagged for supplier review, 9 confirmed high-cost
insights.text: MAIZE/CORN, CORN FOB, SOYMEAL CIF, SOYMEAL CIF Hi-Pro, ANIMAL FEED, DICALCIUM PHOSPHATE (DCP), L-LYSINE, AMINO ACID (FEED), FEED ADDITIVE carry confirmed High Cost signals versus alternative sourcing, while 48 additional materials are flagged for supplier review.

insights.title: 17 materials still lack a confirmed origin
insights.text: 17 of the tracked materials have no confirmed Akij sourcing country on file yet — largely the newly added feed premix, supplement, and specialty meal lines.
